_note: The review checklist. Draft wording for the team to agree: edit it here, then run scripts/build-data.ps1. 'common' applies to every report; 'families' adds items by the pack's scoringFamily, and 'instruments' by its instrumentId. Each item's id must stay stable: the answers in a review file are keyed by it.

common.text: The scope and exclusions are right.
The client details and document control are correct.
The recommendations are specific and can be acted on.
The language is fit for the client.

capability-sl.text: Each zone's target levels are justified, and the source of the target is stated.
Answers shared across zones really do apply to every zone that inherits them.

caf-achieved.text: The profile chosen is the right one for this organisation, and the report says why.
The report does not read as a formal regulator's assessment.

domain-letter.text: The headline grade matches what the findings say.

program-maturity-ml.text: Each maturity level claimed has evidence of the process running, not only of it being written down.

nis2-conformance.text: The report says it is not a legal determination of NIS2 compliance.
The entity classification and competent authority are stated correctly.

csms-conformance.text: Elements marked as in place have evidence of use, not only of a document.

risk-appetite-coherence.text: The verdict is the consultant's judgement, with the reasoning stated.
The decision put to the board is clear.

risk-assessment.text: The tolerable risk has been agreed with the asset owner.
Each zone and conduit's target level follows from its risk assessment.
Risks above the tolerable level each have a disposition: a countermeasure, the target level, or a recorded acceptance.

eu-cra.text: The report says it is not a conformity assessment or a legal determination under the CRA.
The product classification and the conformity route are right.

eu-machinery.text: The report says it is not a conformity assessment or a legal determination under the Machinery Regulation.
The machine's Annex I classification and the conformity route are right.

onr-syaps-management.text: The report says it is not an ONR assessment and carries no regulatory standing.

onr-syaps-cyber.text: The report says it is not an ONR assessment and carries no regulatory standing.

onr-syaps-full.text: The report says it is not an ONR assessment and carries no regulatory standing.
